scenario: LGRA.10.3.3 — the action-argument inventory is closed. `log` takes a level and a message and NO kwargs, so `category:` is DS_VALIDATE_BAD_KWARG. ActionLog's proto comment says the executor supplies the log category from the TerminalNode's rule_name, so an author-supplied one would be silently OVERRIDDEN.

schema Trig scope logical:
    v: Int key

rule r:

->
    log info "hello" category: "net"
